intent: one KPI with label, value, optional delta/trend/hint/badge
useWhen: Showing a single metric such as revenue, users, or conversion rate
doNotUseWhen: Charts, sparklines, or tables — out of scope for this contract
A framed content tile — use Card
A recommended action tile — use InsightCard

badge.note: kit Badge on the header, aligned with label. Compose Badge. No Tag.

onClick.note: When set, the whole card is a button that opens a detail view

fill.note: Stretch to the parent width. Scoreboard passes fill so cards share the row.

requirements: delta text is the visible change
root is a button when onClick is set

doNot: Do not invent a KpiCard, Stat, or MetricCard cousin
Do not use raw hex colors in styles
Do not pack multiple KPIs into one Scorecard
Do not put buttons or links inside Scorecard besides the whole-card onClick
Do not invent a local Tag or Status on Scorecard — use kit Badge via badge
snippet: <Scorecard label="Revenue" value="$48.2k" delta="+12.4%" trend="up" hint="vs last 30 days" />
